decision: Do not remove or relax the canonical breakout-onset requirement in the live v58 route. Treat the favorable current-prefix paths only as hypothesis-formation evidence. Keep the unchanged route and its native 60-bps stop and 12-hour maximum hold while the exact open lifecycle resolves.
why_now: The current v58 prefix contains favorable counterfactual ETH-long paths when canonical onset is the only blocker, but an earlier frozen one-blocker sample was slightly negative after modeled costs and the current prefix is one directional trend episode rather than an independent strategy evaluation.

current_highest_value_investigation.reason: It is the first exact v58 lifecycle under the frozen ETH contract and supplies real entry, fee, funding, stop, hold, and exit evidence.

earlier_frozen_one_blocker.interpretation: Small and one-sided; it does not support live relaxation.

current_live_prefix_one_blocker.interpretation: Favorable but selection-exposed. These paths come from one ETH trend window; many occur while the one-position-per-symbol portfolio already holds ETH and therefore cannot represent additional deployable entries.

open_exact_lifecycle_snapshot.interpretation: The unchanged onset rule did capture the same broader move. The lifecycle remains open, so none of these values are final realized economics.

bias_and_failure_modes: The current prefix is one directional trend regime and path observations are correlated even when horizon overlap is removed.
Counterfactual paths are not orders, fills, stop executions, funding-complete lifecycles, or native 12-hour exit results.
At-or-after-open paths collide with the portfolio's one-position-per-symbol constraint and cannot create incremental ETH exposure.
The current prefix was inspected before this disposition and cannot be reused as future-only evaluation evidence.
Only the long side has current one-blocker evidence; a bidirectional live change would otherwise be selected from one side.
Multiple horizons were inspected, increasing selection-bias risk.

future_only_validation_contract.candidate: canonical onset is the sole removed condition; all other entry, 60-bps stop, and 12-hour hold semantics remain frozen
required_evidence: source-attributable causal decision and first executable BBO
exact fees, funding, slippage, latency, stop-path, and native-exit accounting
non-overlapping prospective paths with occupancy collisions reported separately
long and short evidence reported separately without post-hoc side selection
comparison with the unchanged route and with no action
no validation or live promotion from the current inspected prefix
future_only_validation_contract.minimum_diagnostic_update: At least one technically resolved future-only path on each configured side. This is diagnostic evidence, not a promotion threshold.
future_only_validation_contract.approval_ready_condition: Only a separately reviewed future-only result with positive after-cost economics excluding the largest winner, no unresolved technical paths, no adverse side rotation, and an explicit human-approved live proposal may change the route.

falsifier: Update this disposition if a preregistered future-only, technically complete, both-side source-compatible window shows that the sole onset relaxation improves after-cost native-lifecycle economics over the unchanged route without largest-winner dependence, occupancy distortion, or regime-specific collapse.
